SPY_and_dividend_requests: Freeze exact requests separately only after price-source and reconciliation gates; same source, exact population only
openingPrice_share_units: Must be certified before nominal-share ledger; prior AAPL fixture shows adjusted openingPrice units
reconciliation: Exact(security_id,ticker,day) multiset; exact unadjustedClose; no tolerance declared

request.query:
SELECT o.ticker,CAST(o.date AS DATE) AS day,s.security_id,o.openingPrice,o.unadjustedClose
        FROM lake.sec_daily_ohlc o JOIN lake.security_segments s ON o.ticker=s.ticker
         AND CAST(o.date AS DATE) BETWEEN s.from_date AND COALESCE(s.to_date,DATE '2020-12-31')
        WHERE CAST(o.date AS DATE) BETWEEN CAST(? AS DATE) AND CAST(? AS DATE)
         AND s.asset_type='CS' AND s.security_id IS NOT NULL
        ORDER BY s.security_id,o.date
